hero.title: Power Your Music Business
hero.subtitle: Soncollab Studio offers one unified platform to manage digital assets, supply chain, rights management, business intelligence, financial reporting, and royalty payment distribution.

unified.title: Unified Platform
unified.description: All your music business tools in one place

scalable.title: Scalable Solution
scalable.description: Grows with your business from indie to enterprise

features.title: Complete Music Business Suite
features.subtitle: Everything you need to manage, distribute, and monetize your music catalog effectively.

catalog.title: Catalog Management
catalog.description: Your music catalog is your most valuable asset—unlock its full potential with Soncollab Studio.
catalog.feature1: Organize all your digital assets in one place
catalog.feature2: Manage copyrights and metadata with ease
catalog.feature3: Import and export your catalog effortlessly via DDEX, CSV, or XML

rights.title: Rights Management
rights.description: Simplify rights management and ensure every artist and rights holder gets paid—accurately and as fast as possible.
rights.feature1: Manage and secure your rights with customizable contracts
rights.feature2: Process complex terms with precise rights ingestion for full compliance
rights.feature3: Automate royalty splits to eliminate errors and ensure timely payments

distribution.title: Distribution & Delivery
distribution.description: Distribute your music anywhere and reach fans—fast, seamless, and hassle-free.
distribution.feature1: Leverage direct DSP, Merlin, or Soncollab deals
distribution.feature2: Distribute to 300+ global DSPs, social platforms, and more
distribution.feature3: Ensure quality control with Soncollab's Metadata Inspector

income.title: Income Tracking
income.description: Gain full revenue control with seamless tracking, reconciliation, and real-time insights—all in one place.
income.feature1: Ingest revenue reports via API, FTP, or direct upload
income.feature2: Reconcile payments effortlessly by auto-matching transactions with your catalog
income.feature3: Automatically detect and suggest matches for unmatched transactions

royalties.title: Royalty Accounting
royalties.description: Ditch spreadsheets—automate payouts, track earnings in real time, and simplify royalty accounting with precision.
royalties.feature1: Generate detailed financial reports covering revenue, royalties, and expenses
royalties.feature2: Gain insights into cash flow, earnings trends, and payout history
royalties.feature3: Customize reports by artist, label, DSP, or territory for granular analysis

payments.title: Global Payments
payments.description: Seamless and secure cross-border multi-currency payments and fast, accurate royalty payouts—simplified.
payments.feature1: Automate royalty distribution from calculation to payment
payments.feature2: Manage payments in multiple currencies with automated FX conversions
payments.feature3: Process payments for any number of rights holders—whether one or thousands

analytics.title: Analytics & Insights
analytics.description: Unlock the power of your data with advanced analytics, streaming trends, revenue patterns, and audience engagement for smarter decision-making.
analytics.feature1: Break down streaming and download data by release, DSP, market, and more
analytics.feature2: Track growth, demographics, and engagement to optimize marketing and expand reach
analytics.feature3: Export data in CSV or PDF formats for easy collaboration and reporting

whitelabel.title: White Label Solution
whitelabel.description: Empower your music business with a fully customizable, scalable platform to enhance your brand, extend reach, and streamline distribution.
whitelabel.feature1: Customize domains, visuals, and UI for a seamless, professional look
whitelabel.feature2: Personalize onboarding with branded pages and secure authentication
whitelabel.feature3: Manage labels and artists at scale while ensuring quality and compliance

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Music Business?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of labels and artists who trust Soncollab Studio to power their success.
